fixture_first_record.behavior: The submit-only facade, synchronous admission behavior, discarded-outcome rejection, generic-C no-event oracle, and native OS assertions were authored before reading any staged historical DCT fixture or test.

oracle_only.old_semantics: A descriptor WorkQueue reserves and publishes slots, exposes producer state, then harvests owned cookie/status completion values while preventing reclaimed slot references from escaping.
oracle_only.new_semantics: A caller-owned opaque payload word is handed to a pre-resolved endpoint for immediate admission only; L1 acquires no slot, storage, queue, completion, status, or correlation ownership.
oracle_only.behavior_delta: Only the lifetime boundary was used as a comparison oracle: the new compiler retains the payload solely as a call operand and acceptance is not treated as reclamation or completion. No fixture DSL, descriptor layout, queue state, cookie/status, golden C, or historical IR was copied.

oracle_only.old_semantics: The old suite rejected discarded queue publication results and OS-edge or wire/queue declarations coupled to the rich WorkQueue IR.
oracle_only.new_semantics: The fresh suite independently rejects a discarded synchronous admission verdict and a malformed submit facade; OS endpoints remain opaque L2 operands and no wire or queue schema exists to annotate.
oracle_only.behavior_delta: The result-consumption principle was independently re-proven. Old queue binding, wire attributes, vocabulary serialization, diagnostics, and coverage were excluded.

rejected_assets.old_semantics: WorkQueue reserve/publish/harvest plus cursor, cookie, completion, DMA, and register-edge ownership.
rejected_assets.new_semantics: One intrinsic tag and fresh signature/result-use validation.
rejected_assets.behavior_delta: All historical model and recognition hunks are rejected.

rejected_assets.old_semantics: Rich queue runtime with reservation, publication, harvesting, ownership, completion, and correlation.
rejected_assets.new_semantics: Fresh synchronous admission oracle that stores neither operand and emits no later event.
rejected_assets.behavior_delta: The historical helper ABI and output assertions are rejected in full.

rejected_assets.old_semantics: Shared wiring for the old transport table and its maturity claim.
rejected_assets.new_semantics: Fresh minimal intrinsic wiring plus frozen-ledger coverage.
rejected_assets.behavior_delta: No shared historical hunk or maturity claim was imported.

excluded_collateral: WorkQueue, slot reservation, publish, harvest, producer/consumer cursors, and ring invariants
descriptor layout, doorbells, DMA mappings, payload storage, and host shadow state
completion/status objects, cookie/generation correlation, and cancellation
old generic-C queue helper ABI, generated C, diagnostics, and coverage claims
